Subject: POC Trial Planning & RACI — Clearwater Health

Hi Evelyn — great to meet you on the call this morning. Thanks for taking time to walk through Clearwater's goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on owners and the evaluation plan before the kickoff.

Key success criteria we captured (please confirm or update):
- Accuracy: >= 90% on the provided clinical QA set (clearwater_eval_v1)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 200ms for single-turn text generation in our staging VPC
- Cost: avg token cost target <= $0.004/token (estimate subject to model choice)
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 evidence + audit log access for trial period
- Integration: simple API integration with your staging environment and a small sample dataset (anonymized)

Proposed timeline:
- July 6: Share final success criteria & RACI (pending your approvals)
- July 12: Kickoff + environment access & infra provisioning
- July 13–24: 2-week trial (data ingestion, tuning, evaluation)
- July 27: Joint review / go/no-go decision

Initial RACI (high level) — detailed matrix attached (raci_stakeholder_matrix.csv):
- Redwood (Accountable / Responsible): Marissa Cole — trial coordination and stakeholder communication
- Redwood (Responsible): Lauren Bishop — onboarding, trial ops, evaluation support
- Redwood (Responsible): Aditya Rao — infra provisioning, VPC setup, SE support for model selection
- Redwood (Responsible for security artifacts): Dev Patel — SOC2 evidence, answers to security questionnaire
- Clearwater (Accountable): Evelyn Parker — product owner for evaluation, confirms success criteria
- Clearwater (Procurement): Michael Torres — procurement & contracting (please confirm contact)

Attachments included: poc_success_criteria.xlsx (success criteria + measurement plan), redwood_trial_template.pdf (trial checklist + what we provide).

Immediate asks: 
1) Evelyn — please confirm the success criteria and Michael Torres as procurement contact (email if possible).
2) Clearwater — can you confirm who will own the evaluation dataset and whether we can get a small anonymized subset by July 10?
3) All internal owners — please review the attached RACI draft and flag any changes by EOD tomorrow.

I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for July 12 10:00 AM PT once we have final confirmation.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
